title: Open-system boundary, flux, and state-versus-rate classification
hypothesis: A typed open-system classification can reject equations that mix stock, flux, state, and rate quantities or omit declared boundary exchange, preventing a psyche analogy from being promoted into a thermodynamic law.
null_or_failure: A state variable is added to a rate, heat and work signs float, matter exchange is omitted, a closed-system balance is applied to an open system, Shannon entropy substitutes for thermodynamic entropy, dimensions fail, or an analogy becomes consciousness evidence or a fundamental thermo-psyche law.
test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate system boundary, stock or flow type, state or rate type, heat and work sign, matter exchange, dimensions, entropy domain, psyche label, causal wording, and fundamental-law flags; reject every untyped or cross-category equation.
rollback_or_recovery: Restore the least committal dimensionally typed description, retain the failed balance or category vector, remove cross-domain causal wording, and require real construct and physical validation before any stronger claim.
boundary: Open-system type checks preserve analogy boundaries and do not establish a thermo-psyche law, consciousness, sentience, or personhood.
